324442.name: Friendship Circle San Diego
324442.note: San Diego Union-Tribune, June 2 2019: 'Friendship Circle is a Poway-based organization that connects community members to people with disabilities ... Elisheva Green founded the organization in 2005 with Gilbert-Kaye, Goldstein and others ... When Green launched the organization and planned their fundraising walk two years later in 2007'. Its nonprofit's EIN (20-3472700) is of the 2005 series. Medium: the article doesn't name the Rodals or the Encinitas address, so that it is this listing is taken from the name and the EIN. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page.

5406100.name: Chabad at UCSD
5406100.note: San Diego Union-Tribune, Jan 26 2022: the former rabbi director of Chabad at UC San Diego, 'Rabbi Yehuda Hadjadj, who founded Chabad House on Campus in 2005 with his wife', pleaded guilty in the Chabad of Poway fraud case. Rabbi Shmulie and Mushka Cunin now run Chabad at UCSD (this listing, made about 2022). Medium: the year is the campus Chabad's, and whether the Cunins' center counts as the same one is a judgment. (Wikipedia also speaks of a UC San Diego Chabad house in 1972.) Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page.

118537.name: Beth Eliyahu Torah Center
118537.note: San Diego Jewish Press-Heritage, Sept 3 1999 (Donald H. Harrison, 'A Sephardic Outpost in Chula Vista'): the congregation's leaders 'went to see Rabbi (Yonah) Fradkin (of Chabad of San Diego) and asked him if he could send us a young rabbi ... from the yeshiva of Chabad', and 'After receiving his smicha (ordination), Srugo began serving the small congregation as its rabbi in March of 1998.' So a Chabad center from March 1998. The congregation itself is older: High Holy Days in Chula Vista in 1978, Congregation Beth Torah from about early 1979, renamed Beth Eliyahu Torah Center about 1995 for the Mizrachi family's gift of buildings at Bonita and Central Avenues. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page.

6409781.name: Chabad of Rancho Penasquitos
6409781.note: San Diego Jewish World, Sept 16 2025 ('My Mother's Avinu Malkeinu'): 'About a year and a half ago, a rabbi named Yechiel Cagen moved with his family to our quiet Rancho Peñasquitos and opened a Chabad synagogue in his home', so about early 2024 (the listing number also points to 2024). Counted back, so medium. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page.

7180351.name: The Family Chabad - Greater Poway
7180351.note: Its own site: 'The Family Chabad was established in 2025 and is directed by Rabbi Hershy and Chaya Weinstein.' (therebbesimpact.com: 2024; listing early 2026.) Same dot as Bais Betzalel Chabad of Rancho Bernardo-Poway, which began between 2020 and 2022 (5617397). Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page.

5617397.name: Bais Betzalel Chabad of Rancho Bernardo-Poway
5617397.note: San Diego Jewish World, Nov 10 2022 (Donald H. Harrison, 'Doctor Who Became a Rabbi Runs Chabad Shul in Rancho Bernardo'): the Trestmans chose to sever their ties to Chabad of Poway 'after Rabbi Yisroel Goldstein was convicted' (2020); 'Because people were wary of meeting indoors during the COVID-19 pandemic, they decided to establish at the side of their home a prayer tent where a daily minyan could be held outside. At that time, they named their congregation Bais Betzalel ... because they were not yet formally affiliated with Chabad. Since that time, Rabbi Yonah Fradkin ... and Rabbi Baruch Shlomo Cunin ... have designated Trestman as the North County Inland shaliach'. So it began between 2020 and 2022 (the listing number also points to 2022).

earlier.where: a prayer tent at the side of the Trestmans' home in Rancho Bernardo (then the remodeled home itself; Shabbat services at a rented facility)

157625.name: Chabad @ UCSB
157625.note: Chabad of Santa Barbara's own About page (first published Sept 21 2003), on Rabbi Mendel Loschak and his wife: 'In August 2003, They founded Chabad at UCSB in Isla Vista, growing it from a small apartment Friday night dinner, to a flourishing Jewish Center.' Chabad.org News (Mar 2009) reports the fire at the UCSB center (the earlier 'by 2009'). Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page.

earlier.where: a small apartment in Isla Vista (Friday night dinners)

937211.name: Chabad of the Delta
937211.note: East Bay Times, Aug 25 2010 (Community Digest): 'Chabad of the Delta will host its first High Holidays services in Brentwood ... Services are at 288 Mountain View Drive, Brentwood.' Its About page was first published Feb 2 2010 (https://www.jewishdelta.com/templates/articlecco_cdo/aid/1112462/jewish/About-Us.htm). So 2010; medium because the chabad.org listing number points to about 2009 (Rabbi Peretz and Mashie Goldshmid). A new building opened July 2023. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page.

earlier.where: 288 Mountain View Drive, Brentwood (its 2010 High Holiday services)

3394292.name: Chabad of Richmond
3394292.note: Its own About page: 'Founded in 2017, our mission was inspired by the Lubavitcher Rebbe' (Rabbi Yitzchok and Rochel Wagner, serving West Contra Costa). The chabad.org listing (3394292) was made about mid-2016, before the opening. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page.

3641847.name: Chabad of Alameda
3641847.note: East Bay Times, Dec 20 2017 ('First public menorah lighting held in Alameda'): Chabad of Alameda 'was established by 28-year-old Rabbi Meir Shmotkin and his wife, Mushki, who moved from Brooklyn four months ago to serve the island's Jewish residents', i.e. about Aug 2017. A report from the year itself. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked on the page.
